name: K2-137
description: Star of 3,697 K, 98.9 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

radius.source: Adams et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-137 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

mass.source: Smith et al. 2018, the stellar mass of K2-137 b's parameter set from Smith et al. 2018 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

text.card: K2-137 b crosses K2-137 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Adams et al. 2021.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (st_refname ADAMS_ET_AL__2021, SMITH_ET_AL__2018): st_teff 3697, st_rad 0.29, st_mass 0.463

quotes.title: K2-137b
quotes.card: K2-137b is a hot, iron-rich, rocky exoplanet around the red dwarf K2-137 in the constellation Virgo about 99 parsecs from Earth.
quotes.introduction: It orbits the star very rapidly, with an orbital period of 0.1797 days (4.31 h), at a distance of just 0.0058 AU (870,000 km).
